content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I am encountering an issue when trying to transfer a project from [product_name] Web Editor to a [product_name] device via a WAN connection. I tested the VPN, but I keep getting an error stating that 'your PC and the target device are not in the same subnet.' However, transfers using [product_name] Soft Comfort work without any problem. Is there a way to achieve this transfer successfully?
I don't think it's possible. You may want to start a support request for further assistance.
